description: Audiobookshelf client with offline downloads and background playback Storii is a modern, feature-rich client for Audiobookshelf that focuses on a clean user experience and maintainable architecture. Features: - Stream audiobooks & podcasts with background playback and automatic progress sync - Download books for offline listening – fully functional download manager with pause/resume - Multi-user and multi-server support, including OIDC authentication - Personalized home screen with continue listening, recent series, and more - Advanced library browsing: filters, sorting, series grouping, and search - Customizable player: sleep timer, playback speed, chapter navigation, listening history, and bookmarks - Appearance settings: light/dark/system themes, dynamic colors, pure black mode, custom fonts, font scaling - Flexible navigation: reorder bottom tabs, choose startup screen, label behavior - Server admin tools (admin users): trigger library scans, re-scan/re-match items
